content:
Elena: Hey team — starting intake for asia-northeast3 greenfield bring-up. Need GPU quota + network gating plan. TL;DR: request 16x A100-80GB for staging, + an 8x T4 pool for CI runners, and a short 2-week burst pool (optional) for model warmup. Trying to avoid long lead times.
AJ: Thanks. Can you post a rough cost delta for committed vs burst/spot so we can flag finance?
Elena: Quick math: 16 x A100-80 at committed list will be ~\$36k/mo raw hardware (cloud list), burst on preemptible/spot cuts 60-70% but risk on instability. We'll propose: 30% of traffic on spot for warmup, reserve rest. Need ops signoff on fallbacks.
Devin: Networking notes: vendor requires VPC peering + private service connect for control plane. Also need egress IPs whitelisted for container registries. If we open a temporary public egress for initial bootstrap, ops must lock it after validation.
Sree: Provider quota flow FYI: submit quota via console + attach support case with usage plan. They favor a JSON payload in description to speed auto-approve.
Elena: Posting suggested quota request payload (paste this into provider console ticket):
```
Project: redwood-infra-apne3-priming
Region: asia-northeast3
Resource: nvidia-a100-80gb
Current quota: 0
Requested quota: 16 (initial), +32 burst for 14 days (if approved)
Use case: Greenfield cluster bring-up for production staging and model warmup. Workload: inference evals, single-tenant model load tests, CI smoke runs.
Requested by: elena@redwood.com
Contact: SRE oncall (pager) and infra PM AJ
Estimated start: 2024-09-15
Estimated end (burst): 2024-09-29
Cost acceptance: Finance pre-approved up to \$60k one-time bump for validation phase.
```
AJ: Nice. Include note about network gating + private peering in the same ticket — they sometimes delay approvals without topology details.
Devin: Also sending required firewall snippet for the provider:
```
Allow: 10.128.0.0/16 -> control-plane.example.com:443
Allow: registry.redwood.internal:443 from worker subnets
Deny: 0.0.0.0/0 egress after bootstrap (except proxy)
```
Ops Lead: Action items for handoff:
- Elena to open provider quota ticket with payload (owner)
- Sree to draft cost fallback: reserved vs spot breakdown, and recommended policy for autoscaling groups (min capacity = 8 A100s)
- Devin to create network peering request + firewall SOC change (need approver cc)
- AJ to add finance approval doc and sign-off thread
Elena: I'll open the ticket now and paste the payload + attach the network diagram. Will also tag @quota-bot so we have a ticket ID.
quota-bot: Created support case Q-987654 (provider). ETA for manual review: 24-48h. Link: https://support.cloudprovider.com/cases/Q-987654
Sree: I'll prepare an emergency fallback plan: if we don't get A100s in time, we can prototype on 8x A100-40 (if available) + scale T4s for throughput, but perf reg will differ.
Devin: Validation checklist (short):
- [ ] node image verified (gpu driver + libcudnn)
- [ ] kubernetes GPU plugin running
- [ ] private peering established
- [ ] registry egress verified
- [ ] model warmup jobs queued
- [ ] cost alarms configured (daily burn)
Elena: Putting owner assignments in ticket: owner=elena, network=devin, capacity=sree, finance=aj. Will update here when provider responds. :raised_hands:
AJ: Thanks. Finance wants a simple table later, but initial ok. If Q-987654 auto-approves, can we provision lighting image and boot 4 nodes to smoke test?
Elena: Yep. I'll request a 4-node smoke pool as soon as we get approval.
Ops Lead: Plan looks good. Keep this thread for updates only. If anything blocks, escalate to PagerDuty SRE.
Devin: One last note — include the following gcloud quota check command in the ticket to show current usage: `gcloud compute regions describe asia-northeast3 --project redwood-infra | jq .quotas`
Elena: Ticket created, payload attached. Will post provider reply here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
